title: The Harvest Festival takes over Port Jeff
blurb: The Greater Port Jefferson Chamber's Harvest Festival fills the village Saturday and Sunday, October 17-18: tractor hay rides, a pumpkin patch, farm animals, an inflatable corn maze and plenty of fall fun along the harbor.
short: Hay rides, pumpkins, farm animals and a costumed dog parade, all weekend in Port Jeff village.
bullets_short: All weekend: tractor hay rides, pumpkin patch, farm animals, inflatable corn maze and axe throwing (one activity pass covers most of it)
Sat 12:30 PM: the Costumed Dog Parade, bring your pup in costume
Sun: the Harvest Festival Pie Baking Contest, plus the Scarecrow Walk on East Main St
subject: 🎃 Harvest Fest takes over Port Jeff
